name: Immigration
overview: Scripture commands believers to treat strangers and sojourners with kindness and justice, reminding them that they themselves were once strangers in a foreign land, as seen in Exodus 22:21 and 23:9. The law forbids oppressing or vexing the stranger, emphasizing compassion and fairness in judgment (Leviticus 19:33; Deuteronomy 27:19). Furthermore, believers are called to strengthen and relieve those in need, even if they are strangers, reflecting a heart of mercy grounded in God's covenant community (Leviticus 25:35; Jeremiah 7:5).
